acme_prod_owner: Hey team — we've got a spike of OAuth failures for GitHub + Google logins. Users hit a 403 / 'invalid_state' on the callback. Only repro on mobile webviews behind our tenant-proxy. Started ~09:58 PDT.

carla_support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste one of the failing callback URLs (raw query) and the flow (webview vs full browser)?

acme_prod_owner: Example raw URL from a repro session:
`GET /auth/callback?state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJv...Kd+XnQ&code=0.ABc123`
This one shows a `+` inside the state token. The webview then returns 403.

carla_support: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) Is the proxy/CDN doing any query normalization (e.g., rewriting `+` or decoding query strings)? 2) Do you store the full state JWT in a client-side cookie/session? If the session is lost the server will reject the returned state.

acme_prod_owner: We route through an edge worker that strips tenant prefixes and issues a 302 to the app callback. Edge is on CloudProxy and we have an nginx origin behind it. We do store session in a cookie (signed) with SameSite=Lax.

raj_eng: Can you paste the raw incoming request logs at the origin and the decoded values we get in the auth handler? I want to see whether the `+` becomes a space before validation. Also confirm which mobile webview (iOS WKWebView vs Android WebView).

acme_prod_owner: Logs attached (redacted):
`[edge] incoming: GET /auth/callback?state=eyJ...+XnQ&code=0.ABc123`
`[origin] raw_query: state=eyJ...+XnQ&code=0.ABc123`
`[auth] parsed_state: eyJ... XnQ`   <-- note: plus became space in parsed_state
`[auth] result: 403 invalid_state`
Users: iOS WKWebView and Android System WebView both affected but iOS reports higher frequency.

carla_support: That pattern is consistent with a query-decoding normalization: many URL parsers treat `+` as space for application/x-www-form-urlencoded. If the state contains a `+` literal (e.g., base64 string with padding or other chars), the proxy or a double-decoding step can turn it into a space.

elena_pm: Also flagging cookie/session: if the redirect flow loses the session cookie (cookie chunking, SameSite or path mismatch) then even a correct state will fail because server can't match nonce -> yields same symptom. Any signs of missing cookie bytes in requests?

acme_prod_owner: We did see some broken sessions for long state tokens. The session cookie gets split by some proxies (long cookies chunked) — we already have a ticket for cookie chunking edge-case.

raj_eng: Immediate mitigations (we can deploy quickly):
- Normalize: try treating spaces in parsed state as `+` for validation (accept both). Example pseudo-fix in auth handler:
```
parsed = raw_state.replace(' ', '+')
if validate_state(parsed): accept
```
- Also attempt to URL-decode once less (detect double-decode).

Longer-term:
- Stop embedding full JWTs in the `state` query. Instead store the JWT server-side keyed by a short nonce saved in a secure short-lived cookie. That avoids query-string mangling entirely.

carla_support: Repro steps for you to test locally:
1) Reproduce original failure with curl: `curl -i "https://app.example.com/auth/callback?state=$(printf '%s' 'eyJ...+XnQ')&code=abc"` -> expect 403.
2) Run the patched auth handler that normalizes spaces to `+` and re-run curl -> should return 302 -> success redirect.

mike_mobile: On iOS we saw the issue come from `openURL` call that wasn't using `stringByAddingPercentEncodingWithAllowedCharacters:` on the state param, so `+` could be interpreted as space when the system opened the SSO provider. We pushed a short app-side change to `encodeURIComponent(state)` before launching.

acme_prod_owner: We applied the quick auth handler normalization on staging and ran a small A/B: failures dropped to near-zero. Going to press to prod if deploy looks clean.

raj_eng: I'll push a tiny canary: auth handler will try the normalized path then fallback. Added logs to trace raw_query vs parsed_state. Deploying to 3 edge zones now.

deploy-bot: deploy/auth-handler-normalize-space-to-plus v1.2.3 -> success in zone-a, zone-b, zone-c :white_check_mark:

acme_prod_owner: Confirming prod users are back to normal. Thanks for the speedy help! :tada:

carla_support: Follow-ups: 1) please capture one full raw request trace for any future occurrences (edge -> origin -> auth) 2) let's schedule the long-term change to server-side state nonces and audit cookie chunking in the proxy. I'll open a support follow-up ticket and link to the patch.

elena_pm: Adding to roadmap: "Auth: move state payload off-query to server nonce + hardened cookie semantics".

acme_prod_owner: Sounds good. Closing this thread on our side, will reopen if anything else shows up. Thanks everyone.
